mode.receiveOnlyTitle: Receive only: this station listens but never answers calls by transmitting. Turn it off to answer calls.
mode.answeringTitle: This station answers incoming calls automatically, which means it transmits. Turn on Receive only to just listen.
mode.receiveOnlyPendingTitle: Receive only is chosen: this session carries on, and calls stop being answered when it ends. Turn it off to keep answering.

banner.recovering: Reconnecting to the modem after the connection was lost. Nothing is resent automatically.
banner.fault: Modem fault: {detail}. Use the station again in Settings to retry.
banner.aborting: Aborting. RF activity may continue briefly.
banner.finishing: Finishing queued traffic, then disconnecting. Abort stops at once.
banner.aborted: Session aborted: {reason}. Check the messages marked uncertain.

rig.pttNotFollowing: The rig is not following Mercury's PTT. Check the radio and its CAT and PTT settings.
rig.lostWhileKeyed: The rig link was lost while transmitting. If the radio is still transmitting, unkey the radio by hand.
rig.restartModem: Mercury says it is transmitting but the rig is not keyed after rigctld came back: restart the modem.

notConfirmed.broadcastPortSilent: The modem did not transmit; another program may be using Mercury's broadcast port.

composer.hint: Ctrl+Enter sends · Enter adds a line
composer.tooLong: A message can be at most {max} bytes.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.none: No conversations yet. Type a callsign to start one.
conversations.note: Stations heard on the air are in the Heard tab. A conversation here does not mean the station is reachable now.

transcript.whyBody: The link ended after this message reached the modem and before the remote app confirmed it. It may or may not have arrived. Retry sends it again under the same ID; if it already arrived, the other station keeps one copy.

session.receiveOnlyNote: Receive only: incoming calls are not answered.
session.title: Session

welcome.title: Set up your station
welcome.intro: Choose how MercuryChat reaches a modem. You can add more stations later in Settings.
welcome.answersAuto: Once the modem is attached, this station answers incoming calls automatically, and answering means transmitting.
welcome.startReceiveOnlyNote: Receive only listens without ever answering. You can switch it any time from the header.

profile.simulatorBody: A simulated Mercury in this app, with a station SIM1 that answers and echoes. No radio, no audio.
profile.existingBody: A Mercury modem already running, on this computer or one you name. MercuryChat attaches to its control and data ports; it answers incoming calls unless you turn on Receive only.
profile.optionalHint: The broadcast port carries CQ, beacons and heard stations (Mercury -b, default 8100). The spectrum comes from Mercury's UI link, which is off unless Mercury runs with -G (or ui_enabled = true in mercury.ini). Leave a field empty to go without it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteInUse: It is in use: any session ends at once.
settings.deleteKeeps: Its message history stays on this computer but is no longer shown.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.hint: The language of the app. System default follows your computer's language.

theme.title: Theme
theme.systemHint: Follows your computer's light or dark setting.

custom.name: Theme name
custom.tooMany: You have the most custom themes allowed. Delete one first.

contrast.ok: Passes WCAG AA contrast: text is easy to read.
contrast.warn: {count} colour pairs are too faint to read comfortably (below WCAG AA).
contrast.fixed: Adjusted {count} colours so the theme passes.
contrast.cannotFix: Could not fully fix this. Try changing the background colours too.

file.title: Share a theme file
file.hint: Export copies your selected theme as a small text file you can keep or share. To import, paste it here or choose a file.
file.exportedCopied: Exported to the box above and copied.
file.tooLarge: That file is too large to be a theme.
file.notJson: That is not a readable theme file.
file.notTheme: That file is not a MercuryChat theme.
file.version: That theme file is from a version this app does not understand.
file.badColour: The colour for “{token}” is not valid.

diag.title: Diagnostics
diag.probeBody: Attaches control + data, asks VERSION and BUFFER, reads 3 s of status lines, detaches. Changes no modem setting. Only this computer or a modem named in a station profile.
diag.latency: p50 {p50} ms · p95 {p95} ms · max {max} ms

errors.busy: The app is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.storage: The local database reported a problem: {message}
errors.internal: Something went wrong inside the app: {message}
errors.conflict: That cannot be done right now: {message}

splash.timedOut: Start-up is taking too long. Close this window and try again.

sidebar.label: Contacts and heard stations
sidebar.heardEmpty: No stations heard yet. Stations you hear on the air will appear here.
sidebar.heardNew: {n} station heard since you last looked | {n} stations heard since you last looked

heard.notReachable: Heard is not the same as reachable: a station heard here may not answer a call.

beacon.title: Beacons
beacon.prompt: Beacons were on last time; turn on again?
beacon.noGrid: This station has no locator set, so beacons carry none.

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.lostInSession: Telemetry is lost; the chat carries on without it.
telemetry.throughputTitle: Bytes the peer confirmed this session, per second

strip.idleOnly: CQ and beacons go out only while the modem is idle
strip.bandEmpty: No frequency-list entries on this band
strip.tuneTitle: Transmit Mercury's tuning carrier for an antenna tuner (stops by itself after 30 s)
strip.tuneNoSupport: This Mercury has no Tune: update Mercury to tune from here
strip.tuneUnknown: Waiting for the modem to say whether it can tune
strip.tuneConfirm: Tune transmits a carrier for up to 30 s. Continue?
strip.rigMore: VFO, split, power, levels and meters
strip.pttFaultTitle: Mercury and the rig disagree about transmitting: check the radio
strip.pttCheckOffTitle: The rig's PTT cannot be read, so transmissions are not checked. Start rigctld with the radio's PTT type (for example -P RIG) to turn the check on.

qso.title: QSO record
qso.name: Name
qso.finalNote: Finalised: this record can no longer be changed.
qso.freqInvalid: Enter the frequency in MHz, for example 7.105

logbook.title: Logbook
logbook.intro: Every session's record. Drafts can be changed until they are finalised.
logbook.empty: No records yet. A record starts when a session is established.
logbook.finaliseOnDisconnect: Finalise a session's record when it ends
logbook.finaliseNote: Off: records stay drafts until you finalise them.

macros.noEmail: This station has no email address set
macros.missing: No value for {tags}: fill them in under Settings, Station information.
macros.title: Macros
macros.intro: Text you insert from the composer's Macros menu. These tags are filled in for you:
macros.name: Name
macros.quickHint: Listed first in the composer's Macros menu. A click puts it in the draft; Enter sends it.

stationInfo.title: Station information for {callsign}
stationInfo.intro: Macros insert these into your drafts. Nothing here is sent by itself.
stationInfo.name: Your name
stationInfo.emailNote: Your email goes into a draft only when you choose Insert email in the Macros menu.
stationInfo.overLimit: Over {n} bytes: left out of answers to other stations

share.title: Share with other stations
share.intro: Answered automatically when a station in a session asks for your station info. Only the ticked fields go.
share.emailNever: Your email is never in an answer: send it with Send my email in a session.

about.title: About
about.licence: Free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later (GPL-3.0-or-later).
about.updatesNote: Check for updates opens the releases page in your browser. MercuryChat never looks online by itself.

credit.mercury: Mercury, the HF modem, by Rhizomatica (GPL-3.0-or-later)
credit.dseg: DSEG7 Classic font by keshikan (SIL Open Font License 1.1)

about.openFailed: The browser could not be opened: {reason}

waterfall.howUnconfigured: No spectrum address for this station: add one under Settings → Profiles (for example ws://127.0.0.1:10000/websocket).
waterfall.howLost: Mercury is not answering on its UI link: start Mercury with -G (or set ui_enabled = true in mercury.ini) and check the address under Settings → Profiles.
waterfall.spectrumAria: Spectrum: signal level against audio frequency
waterfall.waterfallAria: Waterfall: the spectrum over time, newest at the top
waterfall.waterfallAxis: Audio Hz, newest at the top

notifySettings.title: Notifications

kind.message: New messages, unless that conversation is open in front of you
kind.callFailed: A call that did not connect
kind.delivery: A message whose delivery is uncertain or failed
kind.heardAny: Any station newly heard (CQ or beacon)
kind.fault: Modem faults and recovery (shown in quiet hours too)
kind.beaconRefused: A beacon that was not sent

notifySettings.lab: Also for Virtual Audio Lab stations
notifySettings.note: Your operating system asks once, when you turn a notification on. Sounds never go to the radio's audio devices.
notifySettings.denied: The operating system does not allow notifications from MercuryChat; allow them in its settings.

message.title: New message from {callsign}
message.more: {n} more new message | {n} more new messages

incoming.title: {callsign} is calling
incoming.more: {n} more incoming call | {n} more incoming calls

callFailed.title: Call to {callsign} did not connect
callFailed.more: {n} more call did not connect | {n} more calls did not connect

delivery.uncertain: A message to {callsign} may not have arrived
delivery.failed: A message to {callsign} was not delivered
delivery.more: {n} more message needs attention | {n} more messages need attention

heard.title: {callsign} heard: {source}
heard.more: {n} more station heard | {n} more stations heard

fault.recovering: The modem connection was lost; reconnecting
fault.more: {n} more modem alert | {n} more modem alerts

beaconRefused.title: A beacon was not sent
beaconRefused.more: {n} more beacon not sent | {n} more beacons not sent

refused.broadcasting: not while a CQ or beacon is going out
refused.pttUnknown: the rig's PTT cannot be read, so the transmission could not be checked

rigPanel.title: Rig
rigPanel.txPending: TX level for {band}: waiting for Mercury

rigSettings.title: Rig
rigSettings.noStation: Choose a station to set up its rig.
rigSettings.restore: Retune to the last frequency when the rig link comes up
rigSettings.testHint: The test opens its own connection and only reads from the rig.
rigSettings.pttPortHint: The serial port (COM3, /dev/ttyUSB0) or, for CM108, the HID device; Mercury opens it.
rigSettings.pttTestHint: Mercury keys the radio for a short tune: check your antenna and power first.
rigSettings.pttHint: Mercury keys the radio. MercuryChat only tells Mercury which PTT to use and checks that the rig follows.
rigSettings.modelSearch: Type to search the Hamlib list
rigSettings.hamlibNotFound: Hamlib's rigctld was not found. Install Hamlib, or set its folder below.

daemon.reused: Using the rigctld already running on this port

rigSettings.freqTestHint: Sets the rig to this frequency, then reads it back.
rigSettings.freqTestNone: The rig did not report a frequency.
rigSettings.flrigHint: FLRig sets frequency and mode only; choose a separate PTT method.

freqList.title: Frequency list
freqList.hint: Shared by every station. Suggested entries are a starting point drafted from the IARU band plans, not official calling frequencies.
freqList.name: Name

bandLevels.title: TX and Tune levels per band
bandLevels.hint: Applied when the rig moves to the band and the station is idle. The Tune level is at the sound card (dBFS) and bypasses the TX level.

schedule.title: QSY schedule
schedule.hint: Times are UTC. The rig moves only when a change is due and the station is idle; a change that cannot happen before the next one is skipped.

audioSettings.title: Audio
audioSettings.noStation: Choose a station to set up Mercury's audio.
audioSettings.hint: Mercury restarts its audio with these devices and keeps them only if they work.

refused.noEmail: no email is set for this station

info.noEmail: No email is set for this station
info.olderPeer: {peer} runs an older MercuryChat: some session controls are not supported.
info.confirmEmail: Send {email} to {peer}? It goes once, and only now.
info.snrReport: {peer} reports your signal at {db} dB (peer report, {source}, {age} s old)

reason.rate: Asked too often: try again in a few seconds.
reason.noReading: No recent reading of your signal.

refused.nothingToAnswer: there is no QSY to answer
refused.tuneDuringQsy: not while a QSY is under way
refused.transfer: a file transfer is in progress

notify.ownRig: QSY declined: this station's rig can't change now

notify.fellBack: No contact with {peer} on the new frequency: back to {original}

notify.returnByHand: No contact with {peer} on the new frequency: return to your original frequency by hand
notify.abandoned: The QSY with {peer} was abandoned: the link did not drop. The session goes on

stage.fallingBack: Going back to the original frequency

qsy.suggestIntro: Choose up to {n} frequencies to suggest to {peer}.
qsy.noEntries: The frequency list is empty: add entries under Settings, Rig.
qsy.suggestionOnly: A suggestion only: nothing is agreed until a session is.

beaconSettings.intro: Your beacon carries your callsign and locator. Tick more to send an extended beacon; it must fit the listen mode.

beaconSettings.tooBig: Does not fit: {n} bytes too many.

dialog.title: Send a file
dialog.metadata: This is the original photo: its location and camera details go with it.
